result.stdout:
Usage: uiagen {modules|-mso|-adobe|-acad} [outputFolder] [className] [-list] [-compile]
       uiagen -all [outputFolder] [-filter folderlist] [-list] [-compile]
       uiagen {-h|--help|-v|--version}
       modules is a list of comma-separated module names that can be .tlb, .exe, or .dll files, ProgIDs, or names from HKCR\CLSID, TypeLib, or Interface. Double quotes can enclose individual module names.
       folderlist is a list of comma-separated folder paths (with optional double quotes) used to restrict -all scanning.
       -mso: Generate adapter for Microsoft Office applications.
       -adobe: Generate adapter for Adobe applications.
       -acad: Generate combined adapter for Autodesk AutoCAD type libraries.
       -all: Generate adapters for all registered typelibs (or list them when -list is specified).
       -filter folderlist: Restrict -all discovery to servers located inside the specified folders (including subfolders).
       -list: List discovered servers and resolved type libraries without generating code (outputFolder is optional).
       -compile: Build each generated adapter project into a Release DLL in the parent folder.
       -h, --help: Display this help message.
       -v, --version: Display the tool version.
